This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

This pump (boiler 
area pit sump P/P, 2 per unit) discharge the water from the boiler pit sump under boiler to 
water treatment area for treating

احتياطات السلامة

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as 
safety helmet, shoes, earplugs etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of P/P
motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of
P/P motor.

The P/P must be isolated
mechanically by closing delivery V/V.
